`final class RenderThreadFuture<T>`<br/>
**Extends:** `CompletableFuture<T>`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.utils.thread` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [RenderThreadFuture.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/utils/thread/RenderThreadFuture.java)

Future that completes on the render thread once the work it wraps is done, so its callbacks can touch the interface.

## Description

Methods of JOID that load in the background, such as `MsdfFontLoader.load(...)`, return one.
Its callbacks run at the frame after the work ends; `join()` and `get()` called on the render thread wait for the work and complete it at once, without waiting for a frame.
